_note: Stands que la Flèche peut donner. Une entrée = un tirage ; stages = les étapes (actes, évolutions, Requiem), jouées dans l'ordre sur la carte. image = le fichier source sur jojowiki.com (JoJo's Bizarre Encyclopedia), récupéré par tools/fetch_stands.py puis préparé par tools/build_stands.py dans assets/stands/<id>.png. Images © Hirohiko Araki / Shueisha / David Production, usage de fan.

stages.name: Star Platinum
stages.text: ORA ORA ORA! Precise, brutally fast, and it can stop time for a few seconds.

stages.name: The World
stages.text: ZA WARUDO! Time stops, and only DIO keeps moving.

stages.name: Silver Chariot
stages.text: A rapier knight so fast it leaves afterimages behind.

stages.name: Chariot Requiem
stages.text: Pierced by the Arrow: it swaps everyone's souls and puts the whole city to sleep.

stages.name: Magician's Red
stages.text: Crossfire Hurricane: flames shaped into an ankh, hot enough to melt steel.

stages.name: Hermit Purple
stages.text: Thorny vines that take spirit photographs and track down anyone.

stages.name: Hierophant Green
stages.text: Emerald Splash! It unravels into tendrils and hides inside its prey.

stages.name: The Fool
stages.text: A sand Stand for a dog who hates everyone. Bribes accepted in coffee gum.

stages.name: Tower of Gray
stages.text: A stag beetle Stand too fast to catch, tearing out tongues mid-flight.

stages.name: Dark Blue Moon
stages.text: An underwater fighter with razor scales and a whirlpool that strips you bare.

stages.name: Strength
stages.text: A whole freighter that is secretly a Stand. Welcome aboard.

stages.name: Ebony Devil
stages.text: Possesses a doll and grows stronger with every grudge its user holds.

stages.name: Yellow Temperance
stages.text: A living slime that devours whatever it touches and can wear any face.

stages.name: Hanged Man
stages.text: Lives in reflections and strikes from inside mirrors, eyes and puddles.

stages.name: Emperor
stages.text: A Stand revolver whose bullets turn mid-flight. Number two is best.

stages.name: Empress
stages.text: Grows on your body like a tumour, then starts talking back.

stages.name: Wheel of Fortune
stages.text: A car that rebuilds itself, climbs cliffs and fires gasoline bullets.

stages.name: Justice
stages.text: A fog that turns anyone with a wound into a puppet on strings.

stages.name: Lovers
stages.text: Microscopic, but from inside your brain every pain it feels is yours, multiplied.

stages.name: Sun
stages.text: A miniature sun hanging over the desert, roasting everyone below.

stages.name: Death Thirteen
stages.text: A reaper that kills you in your dreams. You won't remember it when you wake.

stages.name: Judgement
stages.text: A genie that grants three wishes, then turns them into killer clay.

stages.name: High Priestess
stages.text: Takes the shape of anything made of metal or glass, even the seabed.

stages.name: Geb
stages.text: A blade of water that hunts by sound from kilometres away across the desert.

stages.name: Khnum
stages.text: Turns its user's face into anyone else's. Perfect for a bad disguise.

stages.name: Tohth
stages.text: A comic book whose prophecies always come true, one way or another.

stages.name: Anubis
stages.text: A cursed sword that remembers every move it has seen and never loses twice.

stages.name: Bastet
stages.text: A power socket that magnetises anyone who touches it until metal crushes them.

stages.name: Sethan
stages.text: Its shadow turns its victims back into children.

stages.name: Osiris
stages.text: Lose a bet to D'Arby and your soul ends up as a poker chip.

stages.name: Horus
stages.text: A falcon's ice Stand: frozen spears, walls and claws of ice.

stages.name: Atum
stages.text: Reads your soul with a yes-or-no question, then traps it in a doll.

stages.name: Tenore Sax
stages.text: Turns DIO's mansion into an endless labyrinth of illusions.

stages.name: Cream
stages.text: Swallows its user and erases everything it rolls through into the void.

stages.name: Crazy Diamond
stages.text: DORARARA! Fixes anything it breaks. Just don't insult the hair.

stages.name: The Hand
stages.text: Its right hand erases space itself. Okuyasu still isn't sure where it goes.

stages.name: Echoes ACT 1
stages.text: Sticks sound effects onto anything, and the words keep echoing.

stages.name: Echoes ACT 2
stages.text: The sounds come alive: touch the word BOING and you bounce.

stages.name: Echoes ACT 3
stages.text: 3 FREEZE! Pins its target to the ground under its own weight.

stages.name: Heaven's Door
stages.text: Turns people into books: read their life, write new rules in the margins.

stages.name: Killer Queen
stages.text: The first bomb: anything it touches explodes. All Kira wants is a quiet life.

stages.name: Sheer Heart Attack
stages.text: The second bomb: a tiny tank that chases heat and explodes on contact. Look over here!

stages.name: Bites the Dust
stages.text: The third bomb, hidden in a witness: time rewinds one hour and fate repeats itself.

stages.name: Aqua Necklace
stages.text: A Stand made of water that hides in steam, rain or your drink.

stages.name: Bad Company
stages.text: A whole army of tiny soldiers, tanks and helicopters.

stages.name: The Lock
stages.text: Guilt becomes a padlock on your chest, and it keeps getting heavier.

stages.name: Surface
stages.text: A wooden mannequin that becomes your exact copy, and makes you mirror it.

stages.name: Love Deluxe
stages.text: Unbreakable hair that grows, grabs and never lets go.

stages.name: Red Hot Chili Pepper
stages.text: Lives in the power lines and travels at the speed of electricity.

stages.name: Ratt
stages.text: A rat's tiny cannon that melts its targets into jelly.

stages.name: Harvest
stages.text: Five hundred little helpers that collect coins, keys and anything else you want.

stages.name: Atom Heart Father
stages.text: A ghost living in a photograph that traps anyone who walks into the picture.

stages.name: Boy II Man
stages.text: Lose at rock-paper-scissors and it steals a third of your Stand.

stages.name: Highway Star
stages.text: A trail of footprints chasing you at 60 km/h to drain your nutrients.

stages.name: Super Fly
stages.text: A steel tower that won't let its prisoner leave until someone takes their place.

stages.name: Enigma
stages.text: Seals people inside paper the moment they show their fear.

stages.name: Cheap Trick
stages.text: Clings to your back, never lets anyone see it, and whispers your secrets.

stages.name: Pearl Jam
stages.text: Italian cooking that cures anything. The side effects are spectacular.

stages.name: Achtung Baby
stages.text: Makes its user, and everything she touches, completely invisible.

stages.name: Earth Wind and Fire
stages.text: Shapeshifts into any object. He says he's an alien.

stages.name: Cinderella
stages.text: Remakes your face to bring you love. Don't break the rules.

stages.name: Stray Cat
stages.text: A cat-plant hybrid that shoots invisible air bubbles.

stages.name: Gold Experience
stages.text: Gives life to anything it touches: a rock becomes a frog.

stages.name: Gold Experience Requiem
stages.text: Returns every action to zero. You will never arrive at the truth.

stages.name: Sticky Fingers
stages.text: Zips open walls, floors, even people. Arrivederci!

stages.name: Sex Pistols
stages.text: Six tiny gremlins that redirect every bullet. Never, ever number four.

stages.name: Aerosmith
stages.text: A tiny fighter plane with a CO2 radar. Volare via!

stages.name: Purple Haze
stages.text: A killer virus in the capsules on its fists. Even its user is afraid of it.

stages.name: Moody Blues
stages.text: Replays the past like a videotape: rewind anyone's last moves.

stages.name: Spice Girl
stages.text: Makes anything soft, and soft things can't be broken. Wannabe!

stages.name: King Crimson
stages.text: Erases time and skips straight to the result. Only the boss remembers.

stages.name: Metallica
stages.text: Controls the iron in your blood. Razors, from the inside.

stages.name: Mr.President
stages.text: A turtle with a fully furnished room inside the key on its shell.

stages.name: Black Sabbath
stages.text: Lives in shadows and pierces anyone who sees the lighter go out.

stages.name: Soft Machine
stages.text: One stab of its rapier and you deflate like a balloon.

stages.name: Kraft Work
stages.text: Fixes anything it touches in place, even bullets in midair.

stages.name: Little Feet
stages.text: One cut and you start shrinking, smaller and smaller.

stages.name: Man in the Mirror
stages.image: Man in the Mirror Infobox Anime.png
stages.text: Pulls you into a mirror world where only what it allows can follow.

stages.name: Beach Boy
stages.text: A fishing rod whose line passes through walls to hook your heart.

stages.name: The Grateful Dead
stages.text: Ages everyone around it. Ice is the only way to slow it down.

stages.name: Baby Face
stages.text: A laptop that raises a Stand child from a stranger's DNA.

stages.name: White Album
stages.text: A suit of ice that freezes everything close to absolute zero.

stages.name: Clash
stages.text: A shark that jumps between any puddle, cup or pool of liquid.

stages.name: Talking Head
stages.text: A tongue that makes its target say only the opposite of the truth.

stages.name: Notorious B.I.G
stages.text: Wakes up when its user dies and devours anything that moves.

stages.name: Green Day
stages.text: A mould that eats anyone who goes lower than where they stood.

stages.name: Oasis
stages.text: A suit that turns the ground into mud you can swim through.

stages.name: Rolling Stones
stages.text: A stone sculpture that shows you how you are fated to die.

stages.name: Stone Free
stages.text: Unravels its user into string, and ties fate back together.

stages.name: Kiss
stages.text: Stickers that duplicate anything. Peel one off and the copies smash back together.

stages.name: Weather Report
stages.text: Controls the weather, from light fog to a rain of poison frogs.

stages.name: Foo Fighters
stages.text: A colony of plankton that learned to think, and to remember.

stages.name: Diver Down
stages.text: Dives into objects and stores its punches inside them.

stages.name: Whitesnake
stages.text: Steals memories and Stands, and keeps them as discs.

stages.name: C-MOON
stages.text: Gravity turns upside down around Pucci: whatever it hits turns inside out.

stages.name: Made in Heaven
stages.text: Accelerates time until the universe starts over. Heaven is here.

stages.name: Burning Down the House
stages.text: A ghost room hidden in the prison, full of things that no longer exist.

stages.name: Goo Goo Dolls
stages.text: Shrinks people down to the size of a mouse.

stages.name: Manhattan Transfer
stages.text: A drone that bounces bullets around any corner, perfectly on target.

stages.name: Highway to Hell
stages.text: Wants company for its suicide: whatever happens to him happens to you.

stages.name: Marilyn Manson
stages.text: A debt collector that takes payment from your body if you lose a bet.

stages.name: Jumpin' Jack Flash
stages.text: Takes gravity away until your blood boils like in outer space.

stages.name: Limp Bizkit
stages.text: Brings the dead back as invisible zombies.

stages.name: Survivor
stages.text: Makes everyone around it lose control and fight each other for no reason.

stages.name: Planet Waves
stages.text: Calls meteorites down from the sky onto its target.

stages.name: Dragon's Dream
stages.text: A neutral feng shui dragon that shows the lucky and unlucky directions.

stages.name: Yo-Yo Ma
stages.text: A butler that serves you dinner, then tries to dissolve you with acid.

stages.name: Green, Green Grass of Home
stages.text: The closer you get, the smaller you become. You'll never reach it.

stages.name: Jail House Lock
stages.text: You can only remember three things at a time. Escaping is impossible.

stages.name: Bohemian Rhapsody
stages.text: Brings fictional characters to life and drags everyone into their stories.

stages.name: Sky High
stages.text: Controls the invisible flying Rods that steal your body heat.

stages.name: Under World
stages.text: Digs up the memories buried in the ground and replays the past for real.

stages.name: Tusk ACT 1
stages.text: Spinning fingernails fired like bullets.

stages.name: Tusk ACT 2
stages.text: The bullet holes move, and they chase their target.

stages.name: Tusk ACT 3
stages.text: Shoots itself to hide inside its own spinning holes.

stages.name: Tusk ACT 4
stages.text: Infinite rotation, born from the Golden Spin on horseback. Nothing escapes it.

stages.name: Ball Breaker
stages.text: The Golden Rectangle's full power: everything it touches withers.

stages.name: Scary Monsters
stages.text: Turns its user, and anyone it wounds, into dinosaurs.

stages.name: THE WORLD
stages.text: Another universe, the same power: time stops and Diego moves.

stages.name: Dirty Deeds Done Dirt Cheap
stages.text: Dojyaaan! Slips between parallel worlds and brings back anyone it likes.

stages.name: D4C Love Train
stages.text: Behind a wall of light, every misfortune slides away into the rest of the world.

stages.name: Mandom
stages.text: Turn the watch and time rewinds six seconds.

stages.name: Ticket to Ride
stages.text: The Saint's protection: any harm aimed at Lucy turns back on the attacker.

stages.name: Cream Starter
stages.text: A spray can of flesh that heals wounds or seals mouths shut.

stages.name: In a Silent Way
stages.image: In a Silent Way Infobox Manga.png
stages.text: Turns sounds into physical things you can touch, and that cut.

stages.name: Tomb of the Boom 1 2 3
stages.image: Tomb of the Boom 1 Infobox Anime.png
stages.text: Magnetism pulls the iron out of your blood and rips you apart.

stages.name: Boku no Rhythm wo Kiitekure
stages.image: Boku no Rhythm wo Kiitekure Infobox Anime.png
stages.text: Pins that turn anything into a bomb when they are pulled out.

stages.name: Wired
stages.text: Hooks that drop from the sky and reel their prey back in.

stages.name: Catch the Rainbow
stages.text: Freezes raindrops in midair and walks on them.

stages.name: Sugar Mountain
stages.text: A spring that gives you a fortune, if you can spend it all before sunset.

stages.name: TATOO YOU!
stages.text: Eleven men sharing one Stand, slipping in and out of each other's backs.

stages.name: Tubular Bells
stages.text: Balloon animals made of metal that burst into deadly spikes.

stages.name: 20th Century BOY
stages.text: Total invulnerability while kneeling. Just don't move.

stages.name: Civil War
stages.text: Makes your guilt come back to haunt you, literally.

stages.name: Chocolate Disco
stages.text: A grid on the ground: anything thrown lands on the square it chooses.

stages.name: Oh! Lonesome Me
stages.text: A lasso that splits bodies apart and slides them along the rope.

stages.name: Hey Ya!
stages.text: Does nothing but cheer its user on. Somehow, it works.

stages.name: Soft & Wet
stages.text: Bubbles that plunder something: sound, sight, friction.

stages.name: Soft & Wet: Go Beyond
stages.text: A bubble spun from an infinitely thin line that doesn't exist. Nothing can block it.

stages.name: Paisley Park
stages.text: Slips into any phone or map and guides you where you need to go.

stages.name: Speed King
stages.text: Stores heat inside anything it touches, then releases it all at once.

stages.name: King Nothing
stages.text: A puzzle-piece tracker that follows the scent of whatever was lost.

stages.name: Nut King Call
stages.text: Screws nuts and bolts into anything, and takes people apart.

stages.name: Wonder of U
stages.image: Wonder of U Hybrid Infobox Manga.png
stages.text: Calamity falls on anyone who tries to chase it.

stages.name: Doggy Style
stages.text: Peels its user into a long ribbon, like an apple.

stages.name: Vitamin C
stages.text: Leaves a fingerprint, and whatever it touched melts into a puddle.

stages.name: Paper Moon King
stages.text: Origami that make you see everything with the same face.

stages.name: California King Bed
stages.text: Break her rules and it steals one of your memories.

stages.name: Walking Heart
stages.text: Long spikes shoot out of its user's high heels to climb or stab.

stages.name: Awaking III Leaves
stages.text: Arrows that redirect the energy of anything they mark.

stages.name: Space Trucking
stages.text: Hides objects, and even people, between playing cards.

stages.name: Fun Fun Fun
stages.text: Puppeteers anyone through their wounds.

stages.name: Born This Way
stages.text: A biker Stand that rams you the moment you open a window or a door.

stages.name: I Am a Rock
stages.image: I Am a Rock Infobox Manga.png
stages.text: Marks a target, and everything of one kind piles onto it until it suffocates.

stages.name: Doobie Wah!
stages.text: A tornado that follows the breath of its target, no matter how far.

stages.name: Schott Key No.1
stages.text: Moves whatever the left hand holds straight into the right one.

stages.name: Schott Key No.2
stages.text: A toxic gas that burns skin, kept sealed inside a soccer ball.

stages.name: Blue Hawaii
stages.text: One touch and you become a zombie chasing the target until it falls.

stages.name: Brain Storm
stages.text: Bacteria that melt the flesh of anyone who touches them.

stages.name: Ozon Baby
stages.text: Raises the air pressure underground until bodies burst.

stages.name: Doctor Wu
stages.text: Turns its user into rock particles that slip inside your body.

stages.name: Love Love Deluxe
stages.text: Controls other people's hair to pick their pockets.

stages.name: Les Feuilles
stages.text: Hides under fallen ginkgo leaves and carries things away along Shakedown Road.

stages.name: Milagroman
stages.text: Money that multiplies endlessly, and you can never get rid of a single bill.

stages.name: Killer Queen (JoJolion)
stages.text: Bubbles that drift through the air and explode on contact.

stages.name: November Rain
stages.text: Raindrops heavy enough to crush whatever they hit.

stages.name: Smooth Operators
stages.text: Tiny operators that move anything, a millimetre at a time.

stages.name: The Hustle
stages.text: Muscles that grab anything touching his skin.

stages.name: THE MATTEKUDASAI
stages.text: Turns into a fake of whatever someone wishes for.

stages.name: Big Mouth Strikes Again
stages.image: Big Mouth Strikes Again Infobox Manga.png
stages.text: Skin that hardens into sand and scatters, so he can slip anywhere, even inside you.

stages.name: Eclipse Eight
stages.text: Attacks from a mist only Stand users can see.

stages.name: Cat Size
stages.text: Three cats spinning invisible strings as fine as fishing line.

stages.name: Bags' Groove
stages.text: Booby-traps any object, and the curse strikes everyone who touches it.

stages.name: Glory Days
stages.text: Controls the speed of his bullets so they hit before anyone notices.

stages.name: Lyin' Eyes
stages.text: Trained nematodes that sniff out the stress of a liar.

stages.name: 200 Balloons
stages.text: Inflates anything it touches until it floats away.

stages.name: West End Girl
stages.text: Dozens of tiny hands that slip into any gap and crush it with a ton of force.

stages.name: Point Blank Seal
stages.text: Stickers that mark a target and spread from one person to the next.
